# agent-calendar

> A local web app that turns Claude Code and Codex CLI session transcripts into a day / week / month
> calendar, with per-session AI summaries, active time per project, API-price cost estimates, and
> resume via Claude Code Remote Control. Single Rust binary with the web UI embedded. Runs on 127.0.0.1.

## When to use it

- You use Claude Code and/or Codex CLI and want to see when and on what you worked, per day and per project
- You want an estimate of what your Claude Code usage would cost at API prices, including subagents and advisor calls
- You want to resume a Claude Code session in the background and continue it from the Claude app on a phone
- You want to start or continue agent sessions from a browser, with screenshots, in your local clones of GitHub repositories

## When not to use it

- You need exact billing: costs are estimates at API list prices, not your subscription bill
- You need a team or hosted dashboard: it is single-user and local only
- You need Codex costs: Codex sessions show token counts only
- You use native Windows: run it inside WSL2 instead

## Commands

- `agent-calendar serve [--port 8082] [--no-summarize] [--summary-model sonnet] [--summary-lang en|ja]`
- `agent-calendar scan` – re-read changed transcripts into the SQLite index
- `agent-calendar summarize [--limit N] [--model M] [--lang en|ja]` – summarize idle sessions via `claude -p`
- `agent-calendar service install` – Linux systemd user service

## Behavior

- Reads `~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl` and `~/.codex/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl`; index in `~/.local/share/agent-calendar/agent-calendar.db`
- Groups sessions by git repository (worktrees fold into the main repository)
- Active time: 10-minute buckets merged across sessions, gaps of 30 minutes or less count as continuous
- Summaries send only prompts and agent text (no tool I/O) through the user's own `claude -p --no-session-persistence`
- Server accepts only Host 127.0.0.1/localhost/[::1] on its port; POSTs need a JSON body and are refused from other origins
- Depends on undocumented transcript formats; tested with Claude Code 2.1.288 and Codex CLI 0.154.0
